dedupe_keys.name: flotation plant process and concentrate quality measurements

description: Eduardo Magalhaes Oliveira publishes process observations from a mineral flotation plant, covering March to September 2017. The CSV table combines ore-pulp quality before treatment, process variables, flotation-column levels and air flows, and laboratory measurements of final iron and silica concentrate. Some channels were sampled every twenty seconds and others hourly; silica concentration is expressed as a percentage. The plant location is not supplied. Kaggle provides free access under CC0. A limitation is that mixed sampling intervals and strongly related output-quality variables can create leakage in forecast evaluation; the single plant does not establish general performance at other mines. Simulation uses include calibrating process-response surrogates and checking predictive quality-control inputs. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with operating-plant process data. The earlier rejection for being a single-plant upload conflicts with the current reusable-resource rule. No data values or model accuracy were checked.
